text:
Houston daa mu wɔ August 30, 1836 wɔ New York real-estate speculators Augustus C. ne John K. Allen wɔ Buffalo Bayou nkyɛn. Wɔtoo ne din de too Texas Revolution ɔsahene ne Republic of Texas president a ɛdi akyiri no, General Sam Houston, na ɔman ketewa no yɛɛ Republic of Texas capital bere tiaa bi.

Efi bayou nkyɛn no, Houston kɔɔ sorɔ kɔyɛɛ United States kuro a ɛto so anan, ne nnipa boro 2.3 million na ne metropolitan area boro 7 million. Ɛbɛyɛɛ energy ne oil-and-gas industry capital a ɛwɔ wiase nyinaa, na ɛwɔ NASA Johnson Space Center — ne din a wɔfrɛ no, "Space City" — ne Texas Medical Center. Ɛwɔ nnipa kuro akɛseɛ a wɔn nkorɔfoɔ yɛ pii wɔ America mu.

Saa nnipa pii no na ɛyɛ football amammerɛ no. Houston yɛ soccer market a ɛyɛ den, na MLS side Houston Dynamo FC ne NWSL Houston Dash na ɛwɔ mu, na wɔbɔ wɔ Shell Energy Stadium. Mexican-American fan base a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ na ɛwɔ ahopɛ paa ama Mexico national team, El Tri, ne CONCACAF events. NRG Stadium — a wɔfrɛ no Reliant Stadium daa — ayɛ United States beaeɛ a wɔde ma USMNT–Mexico fixtures, Gold Cup, ne Copa América Centenario matches, na ɛtwa nnipa 68,000 ne akyi. Ɛyɛ saa ahopɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ no, ne kuro no kɛseɛ ne wiase nkyerɛkyerɛmu no, na ɛma Houston yɛ beaeɛ a ɛfata wɔ 2026 host cities no mu.
